# Infomaniak

Use `infomaniak/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "infomaniak-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "infomaniak/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `INFOMANIAK_API_KEY`
- `INFOMANIAK_PRODUCT_ID`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.infomaniak.com/2/ai/${INFOMANIAK_PRODUCT_ID}/openai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `INFOMANIAK_BASE_URL`.
